name: Tribe Social
description: Platform for custom community apps with courses, live calls, conversations and payments, so creators, coaches and operators "refuse to rent their audience from a social network" (company-stated). Profile says it powers "communities that reach 500,000+ people every month" (founder-stated). No public pricing on the profile. Founded Nov 2024, US, founder Bruce van Zyl. Only 8 active subscriptions, so this is high-ticket B2B: L30 ÷ 8 subs ≈ $1.9k per subscription per month (my arithmetic).

mentions.evidence: MRR $28,271 · 8 active subscriptions Last 30 days $14,980 (0.0%) · last 3 months $44,940 · last 6 months $97,225 Last 12 months $204,070 · all-time $387,308 Monthly range Nov 2025 → Oct 2026: $14,980 – $21,980 (Oct already $14,980). MRR snapshot sits well above L30, and with 8 customers, losing one is a big hit. Revenue synced 19 October 2026 ~04:44 Warsaw.
mentions.indieAngle: White-label "your own app" for one trade association type: Polish chambers of commerce, dance-school networks, franchise operators. A few clients at €500–2,000/month, onboarded by hand.

whyItPrints: A few big creators paying four figures a month each for their own branded app. That's the Kajabi/Mighty Networks white-label tier, sold to a handful of accounts. Monthly revenue has held at $15k–22k for a full year.
